column1: Road to 1.0: Upcoming Changes & Features Overview

To help answer frequently asked questions or just to give more info and a better idea of the update in general, this doc provides a comprehensively organized layout of confirmed, speculative, and unconfirmed features for the upcoming 1.0 release

If you know of anything I've missed or forgotten about here, toss me a message so I can add it.

I will try to keep this as updated as I can -SchwarzFenrir

If anyone has screenshots of each updates in-game roadmap + upcoming features over the course of EA I'd love to have them sent to me to have a better picture of what has been cut, delayed or is potentially imminent.

column3: Details & Notes

Based on the Raven Rock Mountain Complex/Site R in Pennsylvania. Highly anticipated as Objective Map #6.

This has honestly been one of the hardest things for me to sit quiet on, I was hoping someone else would notice the literal writing on the wall before me as this is a really exciting area for a map to take place.

Survival Mode is a wave-based defense gamemode where you protect speakers to draw in and eliminate hordes of Zeds to give the National Guard time to evacuate areas.

Three confirmed maps: Flooded, Night of the Living Dead & Lighthouse.

Self-hosted offline environment. Progression and character permadeath will be completely disabled.

You will apparently be able to progress your weekly assignments through this mode.
Bioscanner objectives will be removed on Powerplant entirely and now "used where they narratively make sense in 1.0; no more shoehorning it into random spots"
Special cosmetic rewards granted to early supporters based on account level, nightmare tokens, and participation during EA.

column3: Return of older clothing patterns (Camouflage, Utility Stripes, Plaid) along with a new customizable graphic/logo placement system.
Plaid
Dedicated slots for Gloves, Eyewear/Masks, Compass and Flashlight are confirmed.
A complete progression and economy wipe will take place at 1.0 launch to facilitate a rebalanced economy model.
Perk Reroll costs will be slashed again drastically as well as item costs in the Loadout Shop

Nightmare Tokens are now no longer account-bound and will instead be tracked on a per-Responder basis, when that Responder dies their legacy will disappear with them. Account Level will become the main way of visually seeing how much time a player has invested into the game.
A new Weekly Challenges system will allow players to earn a new currency called Merits. Merits can be spent on cosmetics as well as "specific, powerful items."

High difficulties will yield substantially better rewards. Slated 1.0 Changes below, Respawns will be enabled on Normal(Previously Classic)Difficutly. 

Nightmare Difficulty is being promised as being much harder in the 1.0 update than it currently is.
The starting sidearm is officially switching from the Model 13 to the MKVII.
Ammo found in weapons will finally be randomized, the higher the difficulty the larger the variable resulting in less ammo.

Baseball Bat is slated for a 'nerf', putting it rightfully below the Sledgehammer. 

"One-handed weapons will be receiving a universal 10% speed increase to their strong attack windup alongside a 20% speed increase to their charged attack windup. This is separate from the actual swing speeds of individual weapons, which are receiving more targeted balance. Two-handed weapons will also receive a 10% speed increase to their charged attack windup"

"Slashing weapons will see 5 stability damage added to quick attacks across the board and 10 stability damage added to strong attacks (for context, 20 stability damage triggers a zombie stagger)"
Difficulty adjustments are coming, including an increased count of zombies per wave.
Quantity and variety of zeds should see improvements on a situational basis. (Threat Level, Difficulty, POI, Etc)

In lower difficulties the delay in spawning that happens while killing zombies in an area will be increased.

Zombie detection will be tweaked even further from the changes introduced in 0.9, giving stealth more viability.

Map difficulty will be made much more consisent so certain maps aren't massively easier or harder.
Sprinting Speed will be seeing a "small" increase as well as a decrease to the time to start stamina regen after sprinting.

Guts

Handgun Reloading
Rifle Reloading
Shotgun Reloading
Perk Improvements/More thought towards breakpoints and respective power of them should be coming.

New "Rescue Beacon" loadout consumable, will be purchaseable with Credits(2000) or Merits(1). 

Having it in your loadout will save your Responder from any death that would delete it. The item and the rest of your loadout will be consumed after doing so.
Full, official controller support is confirmed to arrive at launch.
Cross-platform play functionality is confirmed to be supported across platforms at launch.
Confirmed return of shield-bearing zeds.
Steam Achievements are officially confirmed for the 1.0 update.
Further performance Optimizations will be coming with 1.0.
The price of the game has been confirmed to be remaining at $29.99 USD even after 1.0
The system will be seeing improvements with 1.0, the exact specifics aren't known but I'd expect to see an increase to reconnect time as well as crashes being detected better.

An unstuck system will be added with 1.0, currently it has quite a long activation time and it resets you to your initial spawn so I hope it gets a little more refined but this has been a needed feature.

column2: End of Early Access community events are likely. The specific form they will take is currently unknown; they could be entirely for fun or feature increased XP gains.
A Developer confirmed they are looking into implementing legacy outfits.
More attachments have been teased but it's unclear if they'll make it into 1.0.

A model and sound files has existed for them for quite a long time but it's still just hoping that they'll be included in 1.0.

[Update] Cenelder has said the linked model wasn't fully finished but the sound files do still exist, show your interest to him for this to be added so he is inspired to complete it. More Zombie variety is always welcomed.
Spotted in a developer ArtStation portfolio as a potential new melee weapon.

Anything requiring complex animation work feels on hold at the moment. The team currently lacks animator manpower and is actively seeking to hire. It is realistic to expect features of this vein in post-1.0 updates instead.
Mechanics or additions surrounding the capability of multiple zeds being able to grapple you.
Mechanics involving a bleeding status effect or specialized damage over time.
Explicitly confirmed by developers that this feature will NOT be coming in 1.0.
Confirmed that entirely new firearms are NOT coming with 1.0 (unconfirmed if this applies to brand new melee weapons).
Filling out lacking weapon families like .45 ACP and 6.8 calibers.
The development team has completely refrained from providing any public commentary or status updates on these tools.
It's been awhile now so I guess not everyone will be aware of their previous announcements on this from last year, but this is one of the few things that is NOT coming to the game.

New Player Heads/Faces at this point seem unlikely despite being a massively requested addition, they have a lot of nice looking head models that were made for them ages ago I'll add here later but I would think they'd be teasing if new heads were going to be coming in 1.0.
